boundary: Developer documentation examples can reveal metadata contradictions. This is not current DE runtime proof.

up-remove-objects.name: up-remove-objects
up-remove-objects.description: Remove search results whose selected data satisfy the comparison.
up-remove-objects.note: The raw metadata labels parameter 3 as typeOp, but the developer's own example uses a plain < comparison. The demonstrated < subset is independently recorded here; other operators require separate verification.
up-remove-objects.source_example_description: Remove objects from the local search results with less than 20 hitpoints.

up-object-data.name: up-object-data
up-object-data.description: Compare data of the current target object.
up-object-data.note: Developer example uses a plain > comparison. The raw metadata compare field must not be assumed to mean a c:/g: prefixed operator.
